jobs.descriptionText:
Who We Are Looking For
We are seeking a highly accomplished sales professional to join State Street Markets’ Execution, Financing and Clearing division. The
Execution, Financing, and Clearing Sales, Vice President
will originate new business and deepen existing client relationships across APAC, with a primary focus on Execution platform sales together with our growing synthetic prime brokerage business.
Execution platform product set spans global sales and trading, electronic trading, currency management and outsourced trading solutions, Financing and Clearing – Prime Services (physical and synthetics (TRS), Securities Lending and Repo Trading. Within our Financing and Clearing product suite, the role will have particular focus on synthetic prime brokerage, while also support our cash prime brokerage, securities lending and repo trading businesses.
The ideal candidate will bring deep market expertise, strong industry relationships, and a proven track record of delivering commercial results.
Why this role is important to us
The team you will be joining is part of State Street Markets (SSM). When owners and managers of institutional assets need research, trading, securities lending and innovative portfolio strategies, they turn to SSM. As our investment research and trading arm, SSM’s primary goal is to enhance and preserve clients’ portfolio values by applying technology, optimizing trading and linking asset classes and markets around the world. This position sits within State Street Markets’ Execution, Financing and Clearing division, which spans high-touch and electronic trading, outsourced trading, currency management, agency lending, prime services and secured financing.
Join us if making your mark in the capital markets industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.
What You Will Be Responsible For
As an Execution, Financing and Clearing Sales, Vice President, you will:
Execute the Asia Pacific sales strategy across Execution and Prime Services Solutions, specifically growing our synthetic business
Drive revenue growth by developing and managing a strong pipeline through new business origination and collaborating with internal partners to generate referrals and cross-selling opportunities. Expand client relationships while maintaining accurate forecasts and achieving sales and performance targets.
Originate new business across currency management, cash equities, fixed income, exchange traded derivatives, and physical and synthetic prime solutions.
Partner with client management, trading, product teams and adjacent businesses to present a holistic view of execution, financing and clearing solutions, and drive cross-selling across Agency Lending, Repo, Charles River, FX, custody, collateral management and additional client solutions.
Monitor industry trends, regulatory developments and competitive dynamics to identify new client opportunities and provide market insight to product and business partners
Partner closely with Product, Trading, Client Management, Onboarding, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Operations and other stakeholders to deliver an exceptional product experience and high-quality client solutions aligned with the firm’s strategic and risk objectives
Ensure comprehensive and consistent delivery as client needs evolve, measuring success through market share capture, client satisfaction and relevant industry rankings.
Represent the firm with clients, prospects and industry organizations across Asia Pacific, and develop thought leadership through tactical and strategic marketing plans.
Champion a diverse and inclusive culture that encourages innovation, collaboration and diversity of thought in the workplace.
What We Value
These skills will help you succeed in this role
Strategic and commercially minded, with the ability to translate client needs and market developments into actionable opportunities.
Strong client ownership mentality and commitment to building trusted relationships.
Outstanding communication, interpersonal, presentation, and influencing skills, with the ability to engage effectively with senior business leaders, clients, and technical teams.
Highly organized, adaptable, and creative, with a willingness to challenge conventional thinking, drive innovation, and deliver outcomes.
Collaborative and able to work effectively across product, trading, risk and operational teams.
Education & Preferred Qualifications
8+ years of sales experience in equity and fixed income trading, prime brokerage, including physical and synthetic products, or related financing markets, with demonstrated success in institutional client origination, revenue growth and strategic business development.
Strong understanding of global multi-asset-class market structure, best execution standards, order management systems, and related functionality.
Previous experience in sales and trading, OMS/EMS, FIX connectivity, or other aspects of equity and fixed income trading.
Established relationships across the financing ecosystem, including asset owners, asset managers, hedge funds, and other key market participants.
Proven ability to solve complex problems and make sound decisions in dynamic, fast-paced and volatile market environments.
Professional fluency in Mandarin is required.
Type 1 licenses required
MBA or CFA preferred
Additional Requirements
Travel up to 50% may be required
Full time in office role with flexibility to accommodate frequent travel
Are you the right candidate? Yes!
We truly believe in the power that comes from the diverse backgrounds and experiences our employees bring with them. Although each vacancy details what we are looking for, we don’t necessarily need you to fulfil all of them when applying. If you like change and innovation, seek to see the bigger picture, make data driven decisions and are a good team player, you could be a great fit.

jobs.descriptionText:
Who We Are Looking For
We are looking for a Job Title Asst Vice-President, Global Realty Services, Asset Manager for Hong Kong and Taiwan reporting directly to [Supervisor's Title Vice-President – Global Realty Services, Greater China].
State Street is seeking an experienced, commercially focused Corporate Real Estate / Facilities Management professional to lead Global Realty Services (GRS) asset management activities across Hong Kong and Taiwan, based out of Hong Kong.
The Assistant Vice President will be responsible for managing the performance, governance, compliance, and operational effectiveness of State Street’s real estate portfolio and workplace services across the assigned portfolio. This includes oversight of office operations, landlord and vendor relationships, occupancy planning, capital and operating expenditure, employee workplace experience, financial management, and monthly reporting including operational resilience, and alignment with State Street’s global real estate standards.
The successful candidate will act as the senior GRS representative for Hong Kong and Taiwan, partnering closely with regional GRS leadership, business stakeholders, Human Resources, Compliance, Security, Technology, Procurement, Legal, Finance, landlords, and outsourced service providers to deliver safe, efficient, resilient, and commercially effective workplace environments.
This role requires strong stakeholder management, strategic real estate capability, financial discipline, and a proven ability to manage complex workplace operations within a multinational and highly regulated environment.
What You Will Be Responsible For
As a Global Realty Services, Asset Manag, you will:
Key Responsibilities – GRS Asset Management & Workplace Operations
Lead GRS asset management and workplace operations across the Hong Kong and Taiwan portfolio, ensuring alignment with regional strategy, governance requirements, and global standards.
Create an open dialogue with business stakeholders, understand operational objectives, and deliver efficient execution supported by clear communication.
Determine stakeholders’ business priorities and workplace requirements, tailoring real estate solutions while balancing corporate-wide objectives, governance, and standards.
Influence stakeholders to co-create agreed strategic real estate solutions for offices.
Oversee operational management of corporate office environments and associated workplace services, with a focus on service quality, business continuity, and employee experience.
Partner with outsourced Facilities Management providers to ensure delivery of workplace services in accordance with agreed service levels, contractual obligations, and operational standards.
Support office mobilization, refurbishment, relocation, consolidation, and workplace transformation activities across the portfolio.
Lead occupancy planning, workplace utilization analysis, and operational reporting to support portfolio decisions and business planning.
Monitor facilities operational performance, workplace issues, service delivery metrics, and corrective action plans.
Manage operational budgets, vendor contracts, purchase orders, invoice governance, and facilities-related procurement activities.
Drive operational excellence, cost discipline, risk reduction, and continuous improvement initiatives across workplace operations.
Portfolio Governance, Compliance & Operational Resilience
Ensure the workplace operations comply with applicable local regulatory requirements, lease obligations, internal governance standards, and State Street global policies.
Maintain robust governance over portfolio documentation, operational controls, audit readiness, risk registers, issue management, and management reporting.
Coordinate with landlords, building management teams, internal risk partners, and service providers on workplace compliance, site operations, and resilience matters.
Support emergency preparedness, business continuity, crisis response, and incident escalation processes in coordination with Security, Technology, Business Continuity, and regional leadership.
Ensure workplace risks, service issues, and operational incidents are tracked, escalated, remediated, and reported in line with governance expectations.
Support workplace wellness, sustainability, and employee experience initiatives where appropriate.
Vendor, Risk & Stakeholder Management
Manage relationships with external vendors including landlords, managed office providers, Facilities Management providers, project managers, consultants, and workplace service providers across the assigned portfolio.
Coordinate governance meetings, performance reporting, service reviews, and vendor improvement plans.
Partner with internal stakeholders across GRS, Human Resources, Security, Compliance, Technology, Finance, Legal, Procurement, and business leadership teams.
Support regional operational risk, portfolio governance, financial planning, and workplace strategy initiatives.
Financial Analysis & Management
Responsible for budgeting, spend monitoring and forecasting in collaboration with outsourced service vendor.
Responsible for inhouse reporting, administrative ownership on reporting and technology tools.
What We Value
These skills will help you succeed in this role
Critical thinking and maintain a growth mindset, comfortable to challenge the status-quo
Proactiveness - Anticipating the needs of colleagues and stakeholder and eagerness to complete assigned duties. Results driven.
Adaptability – Adapt and work effectively across a multitude of different situations;
Independent learner and Resourcefulness – Eagerly explore new tools, technologies, and processes; quickly learn to use new technologies as they are introduced;
Team Oriented – Collaborate in a team environment (both inhouse and external vendors/consultants; possess a sense of accountability and urgency in completing assignments in support of the team’s success
Experience in preparation and presentation of Facilities and Real Estate business cases.
Education & Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in real estate, Facilities Management, Engineering, Business Administration, Finance, or related discipline.
Minimum 5 years of experience in Corporate Real Estate, Facilities Management, Workplace Operations, Asset Management, or related disciplines within a multinational organization.
Demonstrated experience managing office portfolios, outsourced Facilities Management vendors, landlords, and senior regional stakeholders.
Strong understanding of corporate real estate operations, workplace governance, lease obligations, vendor management, budgeting, service delivery, and operational risk.
Experience supporting office mobilization, refurbishment, relocation, consolidation, and workplace transformation projects preferred.
Experience within financial services, banking, technology, or other highly regulated industries preferred.
Professional certifications such as MRICS, IFMA, FMP, PMP, or related workplace/facilities credentials are advantageous.
Familiarity with operational resilience, business continuity, audit, and governance frameworks.
Additional Requirements
Work Requirement : Normal office hours

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

jobs.descriptionText:
Who We Are Looking For
We are looking for an Assistant Vice President, Market Risk to join the Global Treasury Risk Management (GTRM) team within Enterprise Risk Management (ERM). In this role, you will support independent second-line oversight of trading market risk across Markets and Treasury activities, with a primary focus on the APAC region. You will contribute to regional and global risk monitoring, analysis, reporting, governance, and strategic risk initiatives.
This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated market risk professional to develop expertise across risk oversight, quantitative risk measurement, regulatory initiatives, and risk governance while working closely with experienced risk managers, traders, model specialists, and business stakeholders across a global financial institution.
Why this role is important to us
Global Treasury Risk Management (GTRM) provides independent second-line oversight of trading market risk across the Markets and Treasury divisions, as well as capital, liquidity, and investment risk oversight of Treasury banking book activities. As part of Enterprise Risk Management, the team plays a critical role in safeguarding the firm's financial resilience, strengthening risk governance, and ensuring adherence to regulatory expectations globally.
In this role, you will help ensure that market risks are appropriately identified, measured, monitored, challenged, and governed across a complex global organization. You will also contribute to enhancements in risk frameworks, regulatory initiatives, risk analytics, and market risk infrastructure supporting the firm's trading activities.
What You Will Be Responsible For
As an Assistant Vice President, Market Risk, you will:
Support independent second-line oversight of market risk across APAC Markets and Treasury activities, monitoring risk exposures and identifying significant risk drivers, portfolio vulnerabilities, and emerging risks.
Monitor market risk measures including VaR, sensitivities, stress testing results, and limit utilization, investigating material movements, exceptions, and anomalies.
Analyze risk data, position information, and reporting outputs to support the accuracy, integrity, and effectiveness of market risk monitoring and governance processes.
Perform stress-testing analysis and support the development of stress-testing scenarios, methodologies, documentation, and portfolio risk assessments.
Support independent risk reviews of new products, business initiatives, and changes to trading activities.
Contribute to the enhancement of market risk systems, analytics, tools, and reporting processes, including testing, implementation support, requirements gathering, and data validation activities.
Assist with regulatory initiatives and market risk framework enhancements, including activities related to FRTB, the Market Risk Rule, Volcker Rule, and other applicable regulatory requirements.
Build strong working relationships with stakeholders across risk, business, technology, operations, and control functions while contributing to risk governance, reporting, and project initiatives..
What We Value
These skills will help you succeed in this role
Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills.
Interest in market risk measurement, traded products, risk systems, regulatory requirements, and risk governance.
Ability to investigate complex risk movements, data issues, and calculation outputs with attention to detail.
Strong communication and documentation skills, with the ability to present analysis clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to collaborate effectively across risk, business, technology, and operational teams.
High standards of integrity, independence, and professional conduct.
Education & Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree or higher in Finance, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline.
3+ years of experience in market risk management, treasury risk, quantitative risk, or a related discipline within a financial institution.
Familiarity with Foreign Exchange and Interest Rate products, including forwards, swaps, NDFs, and options.
Knowledge of equity swaps, including equity index and basket swap structures, is advantageous.
Understanding of risk measurement methodologies including VaR, sensitivities, stress testing, and back-testing.
Experience or demonstrated capability in developing analytical tools, reports, or prototypes using Python and SQL.
Familiarity with Bloomberg, Reuters, or similar market data and risk platforms preferred.
Knowledge of FRTB, Market Risk Rule, Volcker Rule, or other market risk regulatory frameworks is advantageous.
Additional Requirements
Ability to work effectively in a collaborative and globally distributed environment.
Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
Willingness to learn, develop technical expertise, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

Hybrid work environment based in Hong Kong.
Flexibility to collaborate with global stakeholders across multiple time zones

Global Treasury Risk Management (GTRM) provides independent second-line oversight of trading market risk across the Markets and Treasury divisions, as well as capital, liquidity, and investment risk oversight of Treasury banking book activities. As part of Enterprise Risk Management, the team plays a critical role in safeguarding the firm's financial resilience, strengthening risk governance, and ensuring adherence to regulatory expectations globally.

In this role, you will help ensure that market risks are appropriately identified, measured, monitored, challenged, and governed across a complex global organization. You will also contribute to enhancements in risk frameworks, regulatory initiatives, risk analytics, and market risk infrastructure supporting the firm's trading activities.

What You Will Be Responsible For

As an Assistant Vice President, Market Risk, you will:

  • Support independent second-line oversight of market risk across APAC Markets and Treasury activities, monitoring risk exposures and identifying significant risk drivers, portfolio vulnerabilities, and emerging risks.
  • Monitor market risk measures including VaR, sensitivities, stress testing results, and limit utilization, investigating material movements, exceptions, and anomalies.
  • Analyze risk data, position information, and reporting outputs to support the accuracy, integrity, and effectiveness of market risk monitoring and governance processes.
  • Perform stress-testing analysis and support the development of stress-testing scenarios, methodologies, documentation, and portfolio risk assessments.
  • Support independent risk reviews of new products, business initiatives, and changes to trading activities.
  • Contribute to the enhancement of market risk systems, analytics, tools, and reporting processes, including testing, implementation support, requirements gathering, and data validation activities.
  • Assist with regulatory initiatives and market risk framework enhancements, including activities related to FRTB, the Market Risk Rule, Volcker Rule, and other applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Build strong working relationships with stakeholders across risk, business, technology, operations, and control functions while contributing to risk governance, reporting, and project initiatives..


What We Value

These skills will help you succeed in this role

  • Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills.
  • Interest in market risk measurement, traded products, risk systems, regulatory requirements, and risk governance.
  • Ability to investigate complex risk movements, data issues, and calculation outputs with attention to detail.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills, with the ability to present analysis clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across risk, business, technology, and operational teams.
  • High standards of integrity, independence, and professional conduct.


Education & Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Finance, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • 3+ years of experience in market risk management, treasury risk, quantitative risk, or a related discipline within a financial institution.
  • Familiarity with Foreign Exchange and Interest Rate products, including forwards, swaps, NDFs, and options.
  • Knowledge of equity swaps, including equity index and basket swap structures, is advantageous.
  • Understanding of risk measurement methodologies including VaR, sensitivities, stress testing, and back-testing.
  • Experience or demonstrated capability in developing analytical tools, reports, or prototypes using Python and SQL.
  • Familiarity with Bloomberg, Reuters, or similar market data and risk platforms preferred.
  • Knowledge of FRTB, Market Risk Rule, Volcker Rule, or other market risk regulatory frameworks is advantageous.


Additional Requirements

  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative and globally distributed environment.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
  • Willingness to learn, develop technical expertise, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.


Work Requirement

  • Hybrid work environment based in Hong Kong.
  • Flexibility to collaborate with global stakeholders across multiple time zones

jobs.title: Trading Systems Production Support Specialist, Assistant Vice President
jobs.descriptionText:
Who We Are Looking For
We are looking for a senior hands-on individual contributor to provide critical production and operational support for traders, portfolio managers, and investment teams. The role requires strong knowledge of the trading lifecycle, proven L2 support experience, major incident management expertise, excellent business-facing communication skills, and the ability to drive automation-led support improvements. This is a business-facing, in-office position requiring a minimum of four days per week in the office. The role requires close collaboration with traders, portfolio managers, application development teams, infrastructure teams, vendors, and support partners in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment where responsiveness and business impact are paramount.
What You Will Be Responsible For
As a Trading Systems Production Support Specialist, you will be responsible for:
Provide hands-on Level 2 (L2) production support for front-office trading, investment management, Order Management System (OMS), Execution Management System (EMS), and market data platforms, ensuring high availability and timely resolution of production issues.
Serve as the primary business-facing individual contributor (IC) point of contact for traders, portfolio managers, and investment professionals, providing timely support and resolution during trading-day issues and incidents.
Use front office and trading lifecycle knowledge to diagnose issues across order capture, routing, execution, booking, allocations, confirmations and post-trade handoffs.
Lead Major Incidents, coordinate cross-functional teams, manage stakeholder updates and drive timely service restoration.
Troubleshoot complex application, data, database, messaging, and infrastructure issues by leveraging expertise in SQL, Unix/Linux, APIs, XML/JSON, FIX, and SWIFT technologies.
Partner with development, infrastructure, vendor and business teams to drive permanent fixes and operational resilience.
Use AIOps, observability tools, and AI-SRE practices to improve event correlation, anomaly detection, predictive monitoring, and alert quality.
Create or support self-healing agents, automated runbooks and AI-assisted workflows for repeatable L2 troubleshooting scenarios.
Maintain SOPs, runbooks, knowledge articles, operational metrics, and support documentation.
What We Value
Strong knowledge of trading workflows, OMS/EMS, market data and business-critical front office applications. Good understanding of the full trading lifecycle, including order capture, routing, execution, trade booking, allocations, confirmations, reconciliations and settlement dependencies.
Hands-on expertise in SQL, Unix/Linux, Shell scripting, Autosys or enterprise scheduling tools.
Working knowledge of FIX protocol, SWIFT protocol, APIs, XML, JSON and messaging-based application flows.
Experience with ServiceNow (SNOW) and ITL practices (Incident Management, Problem Management and Change Management).
Cloud support exposure across AWS, Azure or hybrid cloud environments.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong contributor with a high level of motivation, capable of taking initiative, setting priorities, and executing tasks with minimal guidance.
Strong communication skills with proven ability to lead major incident (MI) calls and interact with senior business stakeholders.
Exposure to equities, fixed income, FX, derivatives, ETFs or multi-asset front office environments.
Experience with AIOps, observability tools, DevOps, SRE or platform engineering practices.
Hands-on exposure to self-healing automation, AI-powered operational assistants or autonomous remediation workflows.
AI-SRE mindset focused on automation, resilience, proactive monitoring and reduction of manual support effort.
Education & Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, Finance, or a related field.
8+ years of experience in front office production support / trading systems support within asset management, capital markets or financial services.
Technology/Operations certifications such as ITIL Foundation, ServiceNow CSA, AWS/Azure Cloud, SRE/AIOps, AI or Generative AI certifications.
Domain certifications such as CFA Investment Foundations, CFI Capital Markets & Securities Analyst, Hong Kong Securities and Investment Institute certifications.
Additional Requirements
Work Requirement
Ability to work from office at least four days per week, in alignment with the business-facing requirements of the role.

jobs.descriptionText:
Who We Are Looking For
We are looking for entry-level candidates to join our State Street Markets (SSM) Professional Development Program (PDP). This program is a full-time
TWO-YEAR
career opportunity that is key to our commitment to develop diverse and junior talent and is designed to provide strategic and comprehensive training across our Sales, Trading, Financing and Platform business lines. Selected candidates are eligible to participate in minimum 4 assignments across Markets. The platform has several focus areas, sponsored by our global sales and trading teams and each assignment is designed to provide key learning and growth opportunities and foster a deeper understanding of State Street Markets.
Why this role is important to us
The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Markets (SSM). When owners and managers of institutional assets need research, trading, securities lending and innovative portfolio strategies, they turn to SSM business unit. As our investment research and trading arm, SSM’s number one goal is to enhance and preserve our clients’ portfolio values by applying technology, optimizing trading, and linking asset classes and markets across the world. Join us if making your mark in the capital markets industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.
What You Will Be Responsible For
A role as a State Street Markets Entry-Level Rotational – Professional Development Program, Senior Associate will include
An intensive State Street Markets orientation at our offices
3 to 6-month assignments designed to accelerate the development of critical Markets knowledge, skills and experience
Access to training courses on financial markets, sponsorship for CFA and essential business skills will be provided
Exposure to senior management and a support network of mentors at all management levels
What We Value
In this role, you will partner regularly with Markets business teams, providing support for key centrally managed initiatives. This includes delivering data-driven insights and trend analysis, contributing to product development efforts, coordinating strategic and ad hoc projects, and supporting business leadership on day-to-day priorities.
The Candidate Will Be Intellectually Curious And Have An Enthusiasm For Learning And Developing; Be Self-motivated, Adaptable And Willing To Take On New Challenges; And Should Expect To Develop, Or Further Enhance, The Following Skills:
Demonstrated critical thinking skills and willingness to ask tough questions
Sound judgment and business sense
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Keen interest in global financial markets
High drive to succeed
Superior work ethic
Education & Preferred Qualifications
An undergraduate degree, other relevant qualifications (e.g. CFA) or significant work experience
Foundational understanding of financial markets, asset classes, and the role of financial institutions in the global economy, and ideally first experiences from internships
Proven ability to work in a dynamic, fluid, fast-paced, high-energy environment
Strong passion for learning and commitment to career development
Excellent verbal and written skills
Outstanding interpersonal skills are required to work in our collegial, collaborative environment
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel, working knowledge of MS Power Automate, MS Power Apps, Power BI is considered a plus
Candidates must be able to work on a full-time basis from July 2027

We provide investment servicing, data & analytics, investment research & trading and investment management to institutional clients.

Details vary by location, but you may expect generous medical care, insurance and savings plans, among other perks. You’ll have access to flexible Work Programs to help you match your needs. And our wealth of development programs and educational support will help you reach your full potential.

We warmly welcome candidates of diverse origin, background, ability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and personality. Another fundamental value at State Street is active engagement with our communities around the world, both as a partner and a leader. You will have tools to help balance your professional and personal life, paid volunteer days, matching gift programs and access to employee networks that help you stay connected to what matters to you.

jobs.descriptionText:
Who We Are Looking For
This supervisory position is within the Private Equity Fund Services business unit of the State Street Alternative Investment Services Group.
Fund Administration Managers, Officers interact with all levels of professionals both internally and externally. Therefore, exceptional interpersonal and communication skills are required. Candidates must demonstrate initiative, be able to perform well under pressure and simultaneously handle multiple assignments. Fund Administration Managers are responsible to direct the day-to-day accounting and administration for several client sponsored investment funds.
What You Will Be Responsible For
Client Engagement
Manage and maintain day-to-day communications with the clients
Manage communications with investment professionals, other client personnel, investors, attorneys, auditors, bankers etc.
Engage in the thorough review and understanding of investment fund legal documents, including complete understanding of partnership allocations and distribution waterfalls
Service Delivery
Adhere to State Street Alternative Investment Solutions (AIS) strict internal control procedures.
Ensure monthly and quarterly client deliverables are meet
Display ability to performance variance analysis to explain significant movements from quarter to quarter.
Review quarterly and annual financial work papers including portfolio schedules, accruals, partner capital allocations and tax work paper packages.
During the course of normal day to day operation, responsible for identifying any unusual or potentially suspicious transaction activity and must report and/or escalate in accordance with corporate policy and guidelines detailed in relevant operating procedures.
Review limited partnership agreements and offering memorandums and ensure compliance with operational and accounting procedures
Coordination of annual audit and tax return preparation with external accounting firms
Service Quality
Undertake full review of calculation and verbiage on Limited Partner capital calls and distributions.
Undertake full review of accounting work paper packages, fees calculations, financial statements and other reports and communications to Limited Partners
Review quarterly management fee, waterfall, capital account calculations.
Manage internal workflow to ensure internal processing and client deadlines are met
People Management
Demonstrate good management skills and the ability to work well with others, individually and within a group.
Assist with development and implementation of training all levels of accounting staff
Supervision of subordinate staff (including Associate 1, Associate 2 and Senior Staff)
Other Responsibilities
Integrate new business/client onboarding
Coordinate and manage special client and corporate projects
Education & Preferred Qualifications
Candidate must have a university degree (business, mathematics, finance or economics preferred, accounting concentration a plus) and at least 8 years of accounting experience, including 2 to 3 years of supervisory and financial reporting experience is required.
Specific experience in the private equity/real estate industry is a plus, but not required.
Strong computer skills are required, especially Microsoft Office, particularly MS Excel.

jobs.descriptionText:
Who We Are Looking For
We are looking for Assistant Vice-President, Global Realty Services, Project Management Office and Asset Manager for Singapore, Malaysia and Brunei reporting directly to Vice-President – Global Realty Services, APAC ex. India.
You will responsible for leading and managing the APAC ex. India GRS Project Management Office, ensuring the successful execution of Facilities and Capital fit out/refurbishment/Life cycle projects delivery, and maintaining alignment with the organization's strategic goals including Global initiatives as well as leading the onsite CBRE Facilities Operations and Engineering team. In addition, this role is responsible for the Real Estate strategy under the remit, in collaboration with the Global Transaction Team. This position plays a pivotal role in driving project efficiency, standardization, enforce governance framework and overall project management and facilities operational excellence within the organization.
This role must also be instrumental in managing challenging and ambiguity situations with stakeholders and other project members, with the ability to read the room, articulate key message across, and achieve the desired results.
What You Will Be Responsible For
As a Global Realty Services you will:
Key Responsibilities
Program Management Office (PMO) – APAC (50%)
APAC Project Portfolio Management:
Oversee the organization's project portfolio within the APAC region, actively participating in project intake, prioritization, and resource allocation decisions specific to APAC.
Partner and support the APAC Facilities team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement, in tandem with Global policies.
Develop and implement a visionary APAC PMO strategy that aligns with the organization's global strategic objectives.
Collaborate with APAC ex India GRS senior leadership to ensure that regional project initiatives align with the organization's long-term vision and global goals.
Regional Project Governance:
Define and enforce project governance structures, processes, and standards within the APAC region, ensuring consistent adherence across all projects.
Establish and maintain project charters, roles, and responsibilities, and regularly review project governance for enhancements within APAC.
Project Delivery Excellence:
Proactively monitor and assess project progress, budgets, and timelines within the APAC region, taking corrective actions when necessary to ensure successful project delivery.
Champion risk management practices specific to APAC projects and escalate issues to senior management as needed.
Resource Management and Development:
Strategically allocate and optimize project resources within the APAC region, including project managers, business analysts, and other critical roles.
Foster a learning environment within the APAC Facilities, providing training and growth opportunities for team members based in APAC.
Continuous Improvement Champion:
Continuously evaluate and enhance project management methodologies, processes, and tools within the APAC region to ensure best practices are followed.
Encourage a culture of innovation and continuous improvement within the APAC Facilities team and collaborate with other regions to share insights and best practices.
Stakeholder Engagement:
Establish and maintain robust communication channels with stakeholders in the APAC region, ensuring transparency and alignment with project objectives.
Provide regular, concise project status updates and reports to keep APAC stakeholders informed.
Facilities and Asset Management (40%)
Lead and develop the onsite CBRE Facilities Team, supported by their APAC Alliance Director
Review and approve facilities operating expense budget, forecasting, variance reporting and accrual management.
Explore and implement efficient ways to improve facilities services through approved digitalization,
Collaborate with other Asset Managers to maintain reporting, policies, physical security, EHS procedures and protocols.
Lead and support local CBRE Facilities Manager in the respective sustainability efforts as a sponsor.
Prepare and organize presentations and analytical reports for regular team meetings.
Liaise with regional team leaders to organize monthly operation reports.
Data Analytics
Maintain department information library and support regional team leaders to ensure that folders structures are maintained.
Provide support for property management and administration through research, filling, data entry and reporting of real estate information.
Transaction Management (10%)
Be the point of local GRS contact in site inspection, selection and support APAC ex India GRS VP in preparation of business case, with collaboration with the Global Transaction team
Support the local lease administrative process
What We Value
These skills will help you succeed in this role
Critical thinking and maintain a growth mindset, comfortable to challenge the status-quo
Proactiveness - Anticipating the needs of colleagues and stakeholder and eagerness to complete assigned duties. Results driven.
Adaptability – Adapt and work effectively across a multitude of different situations;
Independent learner and Resourcefulness – Eagerly explore new tools, technologies, and processes; quickly learn to use new technologies as they are introduced;
Team Oriented – Collaborate in a team environment (both inhouse and external vendors/consultants; possess a sense of accountability and urgency in completing assignments in support of the team’s success
Experience in preparation and presentation of Facilities and Real Estate business cases.
Education & Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in a related field (Project Management, Facilities, Real Estate, Business Administration, etc.). PMP certification is highly preferred.
Minimum 5 years of work experience in Facilities Project Management, Real Estate in a MNC environment.
Proven track record of successful project management leadership, with a minimum of 3 years’ experience in PMO.
Proficiency in project management software and tools (e.g. Microsoft Project, Jira, Trello).
Good understanding of basic accounting and financial principles.
Excellent in understanding in the real estate cycle principles and its dynamics
Experience working in a highly matrix and complex MNC organisation
Additional Requirements
Familiarity with operational resilience, business continuity, audit, and governance frameworks.
Work Requirement
Normal office hours

jobs.descriptionText:
Make Tomorrow Happen. Advance your career at State Street.
We are excited to see that you are reviewing career opportunities available at State Street. Follow the tips below when applying. If this opportunity is not right for you – perhaps you may want to refer a friend?
Are you advancing your own career?

Job Description
We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Audit Manager, Vice President to join our regional audit team. Located in Singapore you need to have a deep understanding of State Street’s range of businesses and services, including Custody, Markets, and Investment Services. A deep understanding of MAS is also required, and experience of regulations across other Asia Pacific jurisdictions will be an advantage. You should have a demonstrable background in applying data analytics techniques and a desire to influence audit execution through additional technologies.
The role is located in Singapore and applies a hybrid model of 4 days on site, 1 day remote.
Why this role is important to us
The team you will be joining plays an important role in the overall success of the organization. Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. To make that happen we need teams like yours to help navigate employees and the organization as a whole. In your role you will strive for cutting-edge solutions, that are straightforward and scalable. You will help us build resilience and execute day to day deliverables at our best. Join us if making your mark in the financial services industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.
What You Will Be Responsible For
As a Senior Audit Manager, Vice President, you will be responsible for audit activities in Singapore, while contributing to the broader outcomes of the Asia-pacific and global audit teams. Specific activities include:
Owning and executing a portfolio of audit projects, managing the planning, assessment, testing and reporting phases in line with audit methodology and OKR standards.
Work as part of a regional team, collaborating closely with peers to provide oversight of entity related projects, appropriately recording applicability and outcomes.
Contribute to regional and global initiatives for the further development and improvement of the audit function
Actively adopting and promoting the use of technology tools to increase audit assurance.
Develop and maintain stakeholder relationships across the portfolio, increasing risk insight and awareness
Proactive development of team members, enabling the achievement of goals and objectives.
Develop and maintain relationships with key stakeholders across the organization, including the banks' resiliency and technology organization.
Communicate audit progress, findings and recommendations effectively to senior management.
What We Value
These skills will help you succeed in this role
Experience leading and supervising audit projects, preferably within the global financial services industry.
Proficiency in evaluating business risks and testing internal controls while applying risk based testing approaches.
Ability to prioritize multiple tasks, working independently and developing relationships with global stakeholders in a fast paced environment.
Strong communication, interpersonal, and leadership ability across all levels coupled with effective problem solving, conceptual thinking, quantitative and analytical skills.
Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, and technical writing skills.
Advanced project management skills.
Fluency in English - written and spoken. Additional language skills are an advantage.
Education & Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in business administration or a financial services related field.
8+ years of experience auditing one or more of the product suite offered by State Street
Audit or assurance experience working in the banking or financial services industry or other regulated industries.
Expertise in understanding and evaluating regulatory requirements
Relevant certifications, such as CIA or CISA are highly preferred.
Additional Requirements
May require occasional travel (up to 10% of the year)
Additional Locations
Not Applicable

jobs.descriptionText:
Who We Are Looking For
Join State Street Markets as the
Head of Markets Client Engagement, APAC, Managing Director
. You will be responsible for leading client engagement efforts across the Markets product suite, both internally and externally, to accelerate growth of the business. You will work collaboratively with Markets product sales and business leadership to define and execute our roadmap for client and commercial growth in the APAC region, as an extension of the global commercial and client strategy.
As a senior regional representative of the Markets franchise, you will connect client needs with the full breadth of State Street capabilities, coordinate the right product and relationship teams around priority opportunities, and ensure strategic engagement results in clear follow-through and measurable commercial outcomes.
The ideal candidate combines deep capital markets expertise with strong commercial judgment, executive presence, and the ability to mobilize teams across a complex global organization. You should be equally comfortable engaging senior clients, shaping account-level priorities, navigating regional nuances, and driving disciplined execution across multiple products and stakeholders.

jobs.descriptionText:
What we do. State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers, and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation, we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data & analytics, investment research & trading and investment management to institutional clients.
Who Are We Looking For
State Street seeks to recruit a Lead Cyber Security Operations Center (SOC) analyst that will assist in the detection, triage, analysis and response to cyber-attacks. The analyst will join our SOC team which will run a 24/7 coverage, 365 days a year model, with a partner team in Singapore.
The SOC team is responsible for analyzing events from multiple sources across a large enterprise network. The SOC will partner with multiple teams in our Cyber Fusion Center including but not limited to Advanced Threat, Cyber Threat Intelligence, & Red/Purple teams.
Join us in evolving our response capabilities to protect State Street, its customers and partners from ever evolving and sophisticated threat actors. State Street’s Fusion Center is responsible for detecting and responding to various cyber threats 24/7 365 days a year, that are directed towards the enterprise.
This role will be Monday - Friday and will be on-site in State Street's office in Singapore.
What Will You Be Responsible For
Leading the cyber incident response process to ensure timely triage, analysis, containment, eradication, and return to service for high severity or long running incidents.
Author incident status updates and closure reports to leadership.
Produce postmortem reports to identify lessons learned and recommendations.
Continuously prepare for incidents by updating and maintaining incident response plans, playbooks and procedures.
Manage and participate in cyber related exercises such as tabletops and cyber ranges.
Measure the effectiveness and performance of the incident response process through KRI and KPI metrics.
Identify methods to continuously enhance the incident response process
Work closely with the SOC to drive development and collaboration
Train and Mentor SOC personnel
Creating an environment which drives knowledge sharing with teams across the Fusion Center
Help developing the Fusion Center mindset and follow the sun model
What We Value
Experience with investigating & managing major/complex cyber incidents end to end
Experience working/leading in a SOC or Fusion Center
Strong operating systems administration skills (Windows, Linux, Mac)
Strong malware analysis expertise
Experience in performing memory forensics
Knowledge of adversarial tactics, techniques, procedures (TTPs) & Industry standard frameworks (NIST, Mitre Att&ck)
Knowledge of IT architecture and operations (computing, network, storage & cloud)
Strong working knowledge of security technologies including but not limited to SIEM, EDR/EPP, AV, ID/PS, HIPS, Web Proxy/Content filtering, AD, PKI and DNS
Master's in cyber security, Information Technology, Computer Science or relevant experience
CISSP, CEH, OSCP, OSCE or GCIH or applicable certification in Security field
4+ years in cyber security SOC/IR type skill role – Incident Response, SOC Tier 3/Lead Analyst, Threat Hunter, Penetration testing, etc.
Financial Services experience a plus.
Software development and/or scripting experience a plus: Python, Powershell, SQL etc.

jobs.descriptionText:
Who We Are Looking For
We are seeking a client-focused support specialist to provide client service and production support for the Fund Connect trading platform. The ideal candidate combines strong operational judgment, technical aptitude, attention to detail, and the ability to coordinate effectively across clients, business partners, and technology teams.
Why this role is important to us
The team is part of State Street Markets (SSM), State Street’s investment research and trading business. Institutional asset owners and managers rely on SSGM for research, trading, securities lending, and innovative portfolio strategies. By combining technology, market expertise, and connectivity across asset classes and global markets, SSGM helps clients enhance and preserve portfolio value.
Join us if you are ready to make an immediate impact in the capital markets industry while supporting a global, client-focused platform.
What You Will Be Responsible For
As a Fund Connect Support Specialist, you will:
Support the onboarding of new money market clients.
Support onboarding and fund maintenance for Fund Connect’s ETF offering.
Assist with onboarding new administrative operators.
Coordinate data setup and maintenance with the Fund Connect development team.
Investigate and resolve client inquiries and production issues.
Review account balances for completeness and source updated data as needed.
Build and maintain relationships with portal providers.
Monitor data, trade, and file-transfer integrations and coordinate issue resolution.
Provide platform training to operators.
Participate in testing and training for new features.
Assist portal operators with maintaining user acceptance testing (UAT) environments, including balance updates and fund information.
Collect and track testing feedback and enhancement requests.
Ensure adherence to operational procedures and develop new procedures as needed.
Participate in periodic service-level agreement (SLA) reviews.
Design and implement operational controls to mitigate risks associated with new business.
Participate in the regional production-support schedule, including off-hours coverage as needed.
Assist with developing and implementing process-monitoring tools, workflow-management tools, and client data-sharing workflows.
Liaise with fund companies on trading, fund maintenance, and onboarding activities.
Support direct and non-direct money market trading models for Fund Connect clients.
Advance strategic initiatives established by GlobalLink and Global Markets.
Manage holiday calendars and client notifications.
Review fund information on the platform for completeness and accuracy.
What We Value
The following capabilities will help you succeed in this role:
Strong attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Ability to build and maintain effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
Excellent interpersonal, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to prioritize competing demands and deliver high-quality work in a deadline-driven environment.
Education & Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience in financial services.
Demonstrated client service experience.
Strong technical aptitude and proficiency with a broad range of applications, including Microsoft Office, Grafana, Freshdesk, Microsoft Teams, and other virtual collaboration tools.
Ability to understand and navigate a complex global organization.
Comfort working in a remote environment, including participating in virtual training and providing and receiving feedback.
Professional fluency in both Japanese and English, written and verbal.
Five or more years of relevant financial services experience, including at least three years in operations or client service.
Working knowledge of the financial services industry and related financial instruments.

jobs.descriptionText:
Who We Are Looking For
We are seeking a client-focused support specialist to provide client service and production support for the Fund Connect trading platform. The ideal candidate combines strong operational judgment, technical aptitude, attention to detail, and the ability to coordinate effectively across clients, business partners, and technology teams.
Why this role is important to us
The team is part of State Street Markets (SSM), State Street’s investment research and trading business. Institutional asset owners and managers rely on SSGM for research, trading, securities lending, and innovative portfolio strategies. By combining technology, market expertise, and connectivity across asset classes and global markets, SSGM helps clients enhance and preserve portfolio value.
Join us if you are ready to make an immediate impact in the capital markets industry while supporting a global, client-focused platform.
What You Will Be Responsible For
As a Fund Connect Support Specialist, you will:
Support the onboarding of new money market clients.
Support onboarding and fund maintenance for Fund Connect’s ETF offering.
Assist with onboarding new administrative operators.
Coordinate data setup and maintenance with the Fund Connect development team.
Investigate and resolve client inquiries and production issues.
Review account balances for completeness and source updated data as needed.
Build and maintain relationships with portal providers.
Monitor data, trade, and file-transfer integrations and coordinate issue resolution.
Provide platform training to operators.
Participate in testing and training for new features.
Assist portal operators with maintaining user acceptance testing (UAT) environments, including balance updates and fund information.
Collect and track testing feedback and enhancement requests.
Ensure adherence to operational procedures and develop new procedures as needed.
Participate in periodic service-level agreement (SLA) reviews.
Design and implement operational controls to mitigate risks associated with new business.
Participate in the regional production-support schedule, including off-hours coverage as needed.
Assist with developing and implementing process-monitoring tools, workflow-management tools, and client data-sharing workflows.
Liaise with fund companies on trading, fund maintenance, and onboarding activities.
Support direct and non-direct money market trading models for Fund Connect clients.
Advance strategic initiatives established by GlobalLink and Global Markets.
Manage holiday calendars and client notifications.
Review fund information on the platform for completeness and accuracy.
What We Value
The following capabilities will help you succeed in this role:
Strong attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
Ability to build and maintain effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
Excellent interpersonal, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to prioritize competing demands and deliver high-quality work in a deadline-driven environment.
Education & Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience in financial services.
Demonstrated client service experience.
Strong technical aptitude and proficiency with a broad range of applications, including Microsoft Office, Grafana, Freshdesk, Microsoft Teams, and other virtual collaboration tools.
Ability to understand and navigate a complex global organization.
Comfort working in a remote environment, including participating in virtual training and providing and receiving feedback.
Fluency in English is required; proficiency in additional languages (Japanese and/or Korean) is a plus.
Five or more years of relevant financial services experience, including at least three years in operations or client service.
Working knowledge of the financial services industry and related financial instruments.

jobs.descriptionText:
Job Description
What we do. State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data & analytics, investment research & trading and investment management to institutional clients.
Who Are We Looking For
State Street seeks to recruit an Early Career Cyber Security Operations Center (SOC) analyst that will assist in the detection, triage, analysis and response to cyber-attacks. The analyst will join our SOC team which will run a 24/7 coverage, 365 days a year model, with a partner team in Singapore.
The SOC team is responsible for analyzing events from multiple sources from across a large enterprise network. The SOC will partner with multiple teams in our Singaporean Cyber Fusion Center including but not limited to Advanced Threat, Cyber Threat Intelligence, Content & Red/Purple teams.
Join us in evolving our response capabilities to protect State Street, its customers and partners from the ever evolving and sophisticated global threat actors. State Street’s Fusion Center is responsible for detecting and responding to various cyber threats 24/7 365 days a year, that are directed towards the enterprise.
What Will You Be Responsible For
Detection of cyber security events & incidents in real time through centralized monitoring.
Analyze cyber security events from multiple sources (SIEM, IP/DS, EDR, AV, Firewalls etc).
Respond and contain cyber security incidents and identify eradication strategies.
Identify process improvement areas and new opportunities in technologies or capabilities
Communicate incident status to Lead analysts and Managers
Creating an environment which drives knowledge sharing with teams across the Fusion Center
Help developing the Fusion Center mindset and follow the sun model
Receive mentorship from other Cyber Security analysts across the Fusion Center
What We Value
Understanding of networking (TCP/IP networks and protocols)
Familiar with operating systems (Windows, Linux and MacOS)
Good all round knowledge of IT architecture including basic scripting ability
A passion for Cyber Security
High level understanding of phishing and malware techniques
Willingness to learn
Strong time management and communication skills
Proven ability to work in a team environment
Education & Preferred Qualifications
Recent Graduates from Bachelors or Masters in Cyber Security, Information Technology, Computer Science or relevant experience

jobs.descriptionText:
Why this role is important to us
With more than US$1 trillion in assets under administration and over 3,500 employees exclusively focused on alternative asset servicing, State Street delivers industry-leading alternative asset services to clients worldwide. We provide a complete suite of fund accounting, fund administration, corporate administration, risk and credit services to more than 500 clients, including institutional investors, hedge fund, private equity fund and real estate fund managers. Our team of alternative investment professionals has more than 20 years of experience working with leading alpha-generating funds, and combines extensive product expertise with flexible and innovative solutions specifically designed for alternative investments.
An opportunity has become available for suitable candidate to join our Alternative Investment Solutions (AIS) team in Singapore. The primary client account for this role is a leading global fund manager with a growing pan-Asian real estate platform with USD 5 billion of assets in Asia. This role is also expected to support other real estate and private equity funds and clients.
What You Will Be Responsible For
i) Client Engagement
Strengthen client relationships. Take ownership of client communication and prompt follow up of service requests
Manage client expectations. Participate in discussions with both existing clients and prospects
Ensure the timeliness and accuracy of client deliverables in accordance with agreed service standards
Coordinate with clients’ internal stakeholders and other service providers including auditors, corporate secretary, law firms, banks and property accountants to ensure smooth service delivery.
Understand fund agreements and documents. Guide staff on the understanding and application of key terms
Advise clients on relevant accounting and reporting matters
ii) Service Delivery
Ensure monthly and quarterly client deliverables meet or exceed clients’ expectation:
Prepare/review management accounts, financial statements and other deliverables including NAV calculations, capital call & distribution notices, fee calculations and investor requests
Coordinate annual audit and tax return preparation with external accounting firms
Respond to ad hoc client requests and queries promptly
Review fund governing agreements and offering memorandums to ensure alignment of operational and accounting procedures
Prepare and maintain robust operational processes and internal controls in accordance with State Street policies
iii) Management
Manage staff to successful and timely completion of client deliverables.
Set goals and career development plans for direct reports in accordance with State Street’s performance planning process. Provide regular feedback and guidance to develop staff
Manage the quality of deliverables from offshore centers of excellence
Coordinate effectively with various internal service teams on client deliverables
Oversee the risk management and compliance of accounting processes.
Initiate and manage ongoing process improvement
Coordinate with other global locations on corporate initiatives and deliverables
Iv) Other Responsibilities
Coordinate and manage special client and corporate projects
Internal reporting
What We Value
Strong knowledge of private equity and real estate fund accounting
Strong client relations and team management skills
Team player with a proactive and positive approach to work
Hands-on, meticulous and resourceful
Problem solving and technical skills to handle complex transactions and structures
Organizational and project management skills to multi-task in a fast paced environment
Familiarity with Investran would be viewed favorably
Proficient in Microsoft Office with advanced MS Excel skills.
Education & Preferred Qualifications
Degree in accountancy. Professional accounting qualification
10 years of accounting experience including with private equity and/or real estate funds, part of which must have been in a managerial role.
Sound knowledge of FRS/IFRS.
Prior process improvement and system implementation experience would be viewed favorably.

We are seeking an experienced Assistant Vice President to join our Alternative Investment Solutions team. This is your opportunity to join a global leader in financial services providing services to some of the world's most sophisticated institutions.

jobs.descriptionText:
Who We Are Looking For
The Business Solutions Specialist plays an integral role in the ongoing relationship management of existing clients to educate clients and prospects in the use, features and benefits of the Charles River Investment Management Solution & Alpha Data Platform (collectively the Alpha Platform) across multiple Asset Classes within Asian Pacific Markets.
The role will additionally involve some participation in pre-sales engagements as required. As a Business Solutions Specialist you will be responsible for remaining current on the latest in the Alpha Platform technology as well as best practices for deployment across our clients. You will leverage your experience with the Alpha Platform to work primarily with Traders, Managers and Operations professionals, ensuring they get the most value from the platform.
Reporting to the Manager of Sales Engineering - APAC and ultimately to the Director of Sales - APAC, this role involves enhancing CRD’s regional footprint within the existing client base to maximise the benefits of the solution and extending usage to other areas of the platform, through active client engagement, demonstrations, one-to-one workshops and targeted client & prospect events. As a subject matter expert, the role works closely with both the Sales, Client Management and Support teams to ensure all product, workflow, and best practice questions and objections are thoroughly addressed.
A core component is understanding the business requirements and the ability to present and demonstrate our platform solutions to maximise value to the client.
This is a senior role and the Business Solutions Specialist must be perceived as highly credible and knowledgeable in both the investment industry and the application of investment management platforms in the front and middle office
Why this role is important to us
The team you will be joining is a part of Charles River Development (or CRD), that became a part of State Street in 2018. CRD helps create enterprise investment management software solutions for large institutions in the areas of institutional investment, wealth management and hedge funds. Together we have created first open front-to-back platform - State Street Alpha, that was launched in 2019.
What You Will Be Responsible For
Based in Singapore, the role involves demonstrating Alpha Platform solutions to many of the world’s most significant investment management, wealth management, banking and insurance companies.
To be a product expert on the CR IMS and Alpha Data Platform.
Liaison between market participants, existing clients, internal stakeholders.
Close interaction with Charles River Relationship Management and Sales team to drive forward end-client adoption of our solutions and drive new opportunities.
Forge relationships with Charles River clients through business and social contact.
Travel to clients and prospective clients across Asia Pacific.
To quickly become familiar with developments of and enhancements to CR IMS and Alpha Data Platform.
Informal training of Charles River Sales team, Relationship Management team, implementation staff and clients in the product.
Assist with RFPs and POCs
The role requires the successful applicant to allocate time as follows:
25% Organise and run client engagements and detailed workshops with business units and end users
25% preparation and detailed product presentation and demonstration to highly sophisticated investment professionals
25% follow-up with clients & prospects to close out any unanswered questions or objections.
10% assist with RFPs or request for information preparation.
10% self training on product featurs and training of internal teams on how clients are using the system.
5% represent CRD at conferences and Industry trade show events.
What We Value
These skills will help you succeed in this role
An understanding of investment markets from a front and/or middle office perspective and what each user persona requires to be effective.
Must have technical acumen to understand requirements and objections and be able to articulate and demonstrate CRD advantages.
Excellent organisation skills; ability to manage multiple complex tasks simultaneously and meet self-imposed deadlines in a dynamic environment.
Foster relationships with senior market practitioners in large and small corporations.
Superior oral and written communication and interpersonal skills.
Able to differentiate and work at strategic and tactical levels simultaneously.
Consultative presentation style to diverse and complex audiences
High degree of proficiency in navigating front and middle office investment applications
Language skills – Mandarin, Cantonese, Korean, Japanese or Thai would also be an advantage, but not mandatory.
Education & Preferred Qualifications
Experience in the financial markets industry is mandatory.
Minimum of 4-5 years of Financial Services industry background and experience with investment management software and/or data solutions,
Bachelors Degree from a leading university in Business Management, Economics, Finance, Computer Science
Additional Requirements
20-30% estimated Asia-Pacific regional travel.

jobs.title: Cryptographic Key Management Operations Engineer
jobs.descriptionText:
Who We Are Looking For
State Street is seeking a Cryptographic Key Management Operations Engineer to support the end-to-end lifecycle management of cryptographic keys across cloud, on-premises, infrastructure, and IoT environments. This role is responsible for ensuring the secure generation, distribution, rotation, revocation, and retirement of encryption keys while maintaining compliance with regulatory requirements, industry standards, and enterprise security policies.
The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise in cryptography and key management operations with a mindset focused on operational excellence, automation, and continuous improvement. You will work closely with cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, and application teams to maintain the availability, reliability, and security of enterprise key management services that support critical financial systems and business operations.
What You Will Be Responsible For
Support the day-to-day operation and security of enterprise cryptographic key management services, ensuring compliance with financial industry regulations and standards, including PCI DSS, GDPR, FIPS 140-3, and NIST guidance.
Manage the complete cryptographic key lifecycle, including secure key generation, storage, distribution, rotation, revocation, escrow, and retirement across cloud, on-premises, and IoT environments.
Monitor, investigate, and respond to key management incidents, including key compromise, expiration, policy violations, and operational failures, ensuring timely remediation and risk mitigation.
Maintain the availability, integrity, and security of key management infrastructure, troubleshooting issues and ensuring adherence to service level objectives.
Partner with cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, engineering, and DevSecOps teams to integrate cryptographic services into enterprise applications, platforms, and security frameworks.
Automate and optimize key management processes using APIs, Key Management Systems (KMS), infrastructure-as-code (IaC), and security orchestration technologies.
Support secure transaction processing and data protection by ensuring highly available and resilient key management services.
Develop and maintain operational procedures, standards, runbooks, and technical documentation related to key management services.
Produce operational, compliance, and risk reporting related to key usage, lifecycle events, service performance, and audit requirements.
Stay current with emerging cryptographic technologies, evolving threat landscapes, post-quantum cryptography developments, and regulatory requirements to continuously improve key management practices.
What We Value
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex cryptographic and infrastructure-related issues.
A proactive approach to operational excellence, automation, and continuous service improvement.
The ability to work effectively across multiple teams and disciplines in a highly regulated and security-focused environment.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into clear operational and business outcomes.
A risk-focused mindset with a commitment to maintaining the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of sensitive data and cryptographic assets.
A passion for staying current with advances in cryptography, cloud security, emerging technologies, and industry best practices.
Attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining high standards of security, governance, and operational discipline.
Education & Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Security, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
3+ years of experience supporting cryptographic operations, key management platforms, information security, or cybersecurity services within a financial services organization or other regulated industry.
Strong understanding of cryptographic key lifecycle management, including symmetric and asymmetric encryption, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), certificate management, and Hardware Security Modules (HSMs).
Hands-on experience with enterprise key management solutions such as AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, OCI Vault, and Fortanix DSM.
Knowledge of security and compliance standards including PCI DSS, FIPS 140-3, NIST, ISO 27001, and related regulatory requirements.
Experience supporting cloud-native security services and enterprise encryption implementations.
Familiarity with IoT security, embedded cryptography, and device identity management.
Experience leveraging SIEM and monitoring platforms to support security operations and key access monitoring.
Experience with automation and scripting technologies such as Python, PowerShell, Terraform, or similar tools.
Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies and collaboration tools such as Jira and Confluence.
Security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, AWS Security Specialty, or equivalent certifications are preferred.
Exposure to post-quantum cryptography (PQC), cryptographic agility programs, and emerging cryptographic frameworks is highly desirable.
